description.narrative: The project development objective is to improve plastic waste management at the sub-national level, and to reduce plastics pollution from municipal solid waste.

The proposed project will be achieved through three components: Component 1: Sub National and Local Technical Assistance and Capacity Building; Component 2: Improvements to Municipal Solid Waste Management and Plastic Recycling; Component 3: Project Management, Monitoring and Evaluation.

title.narrative: C. Reduced leakages of plastics to the environment from improved waste management operations in urban areas.

comment.narrative: Increase in waste capture for other waste streams such as construction and demolition waste and floating waste in the aquatic environment.

title.narrative: B1. Strengthened local plastic waste management in Chongqing

comment.narrative:
1=one intermediate indicator 8 to 11 achieved; 2=two intermediate indicators 8 to11 achieved; etc. Achievement of all 4 intermediary indicators #8-11 would demonstrate improved policy operationalization and central-local coordination mechanism in place.
Indicator 8 ( Mechanisms developed and piloted in Chongqing to increase agri-mulching film collection and recycling )has achieved.

title.narrative: B2. Strengthened local plastic waste management in Ningbo

comment.narrative:
1=one intermediate indicator 9 to 12 achieved; 2=two indicators 9 to 12 achieved; etc. Achievement of all 4 intermediary indicators #9-12 would demonstrate improved policy operationalization and central-local coordination mechanism in place.
Indicator 9 (MSWM statistics/information platforms established and put in operation) has achieved.

title.narrative: F. GHG emissions abatement from improved waste management systems and resource recycling (1000 tonnes CO2e/year) (Metric tons/year)

comment.narrative:
GHG emissions abatement based on bags of kitchen waste processed and plastic recyclables collected.
The value is contributed by Ningbo. -

title.narrative: E1. Improved resource utilization in Chongqing (percent of MSW diverted from incineration/landfills)

comment.narrative:
Percent of MSW diverted from incineration/landfills Baseline: Baseline: 1644 tons/day
Construction of transfer stations and kitchen waste treatment facilities are either undergoing or not yet started. Thus no value available.

title.narrative: D. Increase in waste collection coverage (in pilot rural districts of Chongqing)

comment.narrative:
Residual waste collected as percentage of total residual waste generated (residual waste is defined as waste that is not kitchen or hazardous waste or recyclables). Baseline collection: 34,989 tons/year.
Construction of the transfer stations are undergoing. Thus no value available.

title.narrative: E2. Improved resource utilization in Ningbo (percent of MSW diverted from incineration/landfills)

comment.narrative:
Percent of MSW diverted from incineration/landfills. Baseline: 1767 tonnes/day
This is based on the data collected from the 1036 Smart Waste Cabin Sets installed by Oct 15. 2025, which are connected to the monitoring. The value is below the one reported in last March due to the relatively low quality of waste separation during this period

comment.narrative:
“Quality” MSW separation at source in CQ is measured by the real segregated rate (e.g. the weighted average of the real segregated rate for each of the four types of separate streams, the assessed quality of each stream divided by the total of all four streams).

Total population benefited from project activities

title.narrative: 9. MSWM statistics/information platforms established and put in operation

comment.narrative: In Ningbo, the MSWM platform established is already in operation.

title.narrative: 14.2. Coverage of quality MSW separation at source in Ningbo(percentage of urban households)

comment.narrative:
“Quality” MSW separation at source is defined in Ningbo regulation as "over 70 scores" where the scores is combined by quality of kitchen waste (30 scores), quality of other waste (20 scores), effort of resource utilization (25 scores), effort of plastic recycling (25 scores). The scoring system is defined in the methodology in the "Regulations on the classification and management of household waste in Ningbo City.
The value is provided based on data collected from 1036 smart waste cabin sets installed and connected to the monitoring system. The value is a bit lower than last report due to the expansion of communities and remedy actions to improve the quality of waste separation are under study

comment.narrative:
Share of female ( number of female divided by total number of neighborhood committee for sampled/monitored neighborhoods that will be established in CQ)
No survey was carried out under the project. Thus no update to the baseline value.

title.narrative: 19.2. Number and share of female neighborhood committee members in promotion of waste separation and plastic pollution reduction, as of all committee members in Ningbo

comment.narrative:
To retain the share of female in the newly serviced districts (number of female divided by total number of neighborhood committee for sampled/monitored neighborhoods)
According to the sample survey carried out in another 20 communities, 250 staff are working in the neighborhood committee, among which 176 are female, counted for 70.4%.

title.narrative: 12. Output-based aide system in Ningbo expanded

comment.narrative:
Output-based system in Ningbo expanded to include the 8 districts of Haishu, Yinzhou, Beilun, Jiangbei, Fenghua , Zhenhai, Gaoxin, Dongqianhu.
This is not yet launched, thus no value available.

title.narrative: 8. Mechanisms developed and piloted in Chongqing to increase agri-mulching film collection and recycling

comment.narrative:
A mechanism covering institutional and financing arrangements has been developed for the collection and recycling of agri plastic mulch.
The study has completed and adopted by the relative government agencies
